integrity: The finite-case proof uses exhaustive transitive-order enumeration plus an independent spanning-tree proof of weak equivalence for both extremal quotients; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite T0 Alexandrov spaces of size 1--6; quotient weak cores in the sense of minimal weak-homotopy-equivalence quotients; no assertion for arbitrary larger spaces or weak-point deletion; first example known; source uniqueness and threshold are new claims.
title: The unique six-point source of nonunique quotient weak cores
